text: 【美联储12月或祭出50基点加息？资深预测人士：10月料按兵不动】在美国公布全面超预期的CPI数据后，美联储10月加息概率有所上升，但不加息的概率仍然占据上风。但一位曾较早预测到美联储9月加息的预测人士提出了另一种可能：12月份该央行可能会进行更大幅度、即50个基点的加息。
text_en: [Will the Fed raise rates by 50 basis points in December? Veteran forecaster: October likely to hold steady] After the US released CPI data that comprehensively exceeded expectations, the probability of a Fed rate hike in October rose somewhat, but the probability of no hike still prevailed. However, a forecaster who had earlier predicted the Fed's September rate hike raised another possibility: in December, the central bank may raise rates by a larger margin, namely 50 basis points.
